_comment: The bounded resource envelope the Bootstrap Coordinator validates a host against
before every mutating step. It is authored: these are the capacity requirements of
the install and build stages, not observations of a host.
It deliberately carries no tool version, download URL, or integrity digest. Those
are resolver output: pb/pb/bootstrap_toolchain.py resolves them per run from the
authored requirements in tools/toolchain_requirements.json, verifies each download against
the publisher's own checksum, and writes what it observed to gen/toolchain/.
